issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

metaFields.description: Specifies table meta-fields which will be recorded for each table in Catalog.

warehouse.description:
Base location where catalog tables are stored.
If not set, will use default file system's bucket mount `FileSystemMount.DATA_LAKE/catalog_name`
The url should be fully qualified and include the File system scheme
(e.g. s3://my_bucket/some_path/, azure://my_bucket/some_path/, gcs://my_bucket/some_path/)
Note you will have to add the mount url to the FileSystem using FileSystem#setMount

customProperties.description:
Custom properties to set in additon to the warehouse location
See https://iceberg.apache.org/docs/latest/configuration/#catalog-properties
